subject: MAP: tokenization acceptance matrix & evaluation gating for Sunnova pilot
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Anderson <sam.anderson@sunnovahealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: tokenization acceptance matrix & evaluation gating for Sunnova pilot

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for the time earlier. Attaching an initial MAP extract and a short token economics preview (Sunnova_MAP_v1.xlsx, token_model_preview.pdf). Before we lock the evaluation window, we want to align on explicit cost acceptance criteria so procurement and engineering have a single checklist for the pilot close.

Quick summary of what we need to confirm from your side:
- Acceptance thresholds (example: target cost per 1k tokens, P95 latency budget impact on acceptable unit cost).
- Whether prefix/KV caching is allowed for any user-facing flows (some regulated workflows disallow caching; understood if not).
- Whether batching that increases per-request latency by up to 120ms is acceptable during high-throughput windows.
- Endpoints to be included in the evaluation (chat/generation vs embeddings/rerank) and a sample traffic profile (preferred: 72h anonymized traces).

Target timeline we proposed: 2-week evaluation run (starts after we receive sample traffic), internal decision review 2026-09-30, commercial close target 2026-10-07. If any of those dates are unrealistic for you, flag and we can adjust.

If useful I can share a one-page acceptance matrix inline — otherwise I’ll wait for your high level replies and update the MAP.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Sam Anderson <sam.anderson@sunnovahealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: MAP: tokenization acceptance matrix & evaluation gating for Sunnova pilot

Thanks Karthik — appreciate the materials. Quick answers and a couple of asks from procurement: 

- Acceptance thresholds: procurement wants a clear "cost per 1k tokens" target for the pilot and a separate ceiling if we enable batching/caching. Can you propose numbers? (we don't expect perfect precision — just gate rails).
- Caching: engineering is open to prefix/KV caching for non-PII flows. Anything tied to patient identifiers must be non-cached.
- Batching: we need to understand tail-latency: if batching adds 100–150ms to median calls but reduces cost by ~25%, procurement will want that in writing.
- Endpoints: primary focus is predictive triage (generation/chat) and embeddings for similarity. We'll exclude bulk archival rerank for this pilot.

We can provide anonymized API traces — procurement@ is looped on this thread for SOW and PO questions. Please include a short line item list that procurement can use in their review (cost buckets, evaluation acceptance gates, evaluation dates).

On timing: the 2-week evaluation is fine after you get traces. Our goal is to have a commercial decision by early October; 2026-10-07 looks achievable.

—Sam
Sam Anderson
Head of Product, Clinical AI | Sunnova Health

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: MAP: tokenization acceptance matrix & evaluation gating for Sunnova pilot

Team — forwarding Sam's notes. Short internal play to capture in the MAP before we send v2 to Sunnova:

1) Proposed acceptance numbers (draft) — put in the econ sheet:
   - Generation/chat (LlamaX-13B class equivalent, quantized): target <= $0.12 per 1k tokens (pilot acceptance), ceiling $0.25 per 1k tokens if batching/caching disabled.
   - Embeddings (dense vector endpoint): target <= $0.04 per 1k tokens or equivalent per-embedding unit; ceiling $0.08 per 1k tokens.
   - Expected effective reduction from prefix/KV caching: 15–30% token-level cost reduction on stable prompts; record as a separate line item (cache_allowed = true/false).

2) Latency & batching tradeoffs — capture in acceptance gates:
   - P95 latency budget for generation endpoints must remain < 500ms when batching <= 8 requests. If batching to 16, note P95 can go up to 700ms but must be documented as an explicit exception in the MAP.
   - Any batching that increases median by >150ms needs explicit engineering signoff and a procurement acknowledgement.

3) Evaluation plan tasks to add to MAP:
   - Sunnova: provide 72h anonymized sample traces (start of evaluation).
   - Redwood: run 2-week evaluation with A/B: baseline (no caching, no aggressive batching) vs optimized (enabled prefix caching + adaptive batching).
   - Deliverable: econ_summary.pdf with per-endpoint tokens-per-dollar, cache-hit assumptions, and latency delta table.

4) Who to loop: procurement@ (external), PR/Legal if we need a temporary data permit.

Action items for this thread: Ben - can you produce an updated econ_summary (per-endpoint rows) by EOD Monday? Priyom - please add the gate rows and explicit test cases to the MAP spreadsheet and mark which tasks require procurement sign-off. Olga - quick note about how KV cache behaves for streaming (one paragraph) to add to the Notes tab.

I'll assemble v2 and send to Sam + procurement once we have Ben's numbers.

Thanks,
Laura
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Anderson <sam.anderson@sunnovahealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@sunnovahealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 4 Sep 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: MAP v2 & acceptance matrix (Sunnova) — updated cost assumptions and next steps

Sam / Procurement —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Attached: Sunnova_MAP_v2.xlsx and econ_summary.pdf. Below is a concise acceptance matrix and the steps we propose to keep the pilot moving toward your close deadline.

Acceptance matrix (high level)
- Generation/chat: pilot acceptance if observed cost_per_1k_tokens <= $0.12 AND P95 latency <= 500ms in the baseline run.
- Embeddings: pilot acceptance if observed cost_per_1k_tokens <= $0.04.
- Caching: if Sunnova allows prefix/KV caching for non-PII flows, expect an adjusted acceptance threshold = baseline_target * 0.80 (approx 20% lower). This will be captured as a separate gate (cache_allowed = yes/no).
- Batching: we will run two configurations. If the optimized run uses batching > 8, procurement will see a documented per-endpoint latency delta and a separate acceptance for "optimized" economics. Any optimized econ acceptance must be acknowledged by procurement in writing.

Proposed evaluation cadence and dates
- You deliver anonymized 72h traces by end of next week (deadline: 2026-09-10).
- Redwood to run a 2-week evaluation (A/B baseline vs optimized): 2026-09-13 — 2026-09-27.
- Internal decision review at Sunnova and Redwood: week of 2026-09-28 (aim for 2026-09-30 meeting).
- Target commercial close: 2026-10-07.

Next steps for procurement
1) Confirm whether prefix/KV caching is permitted for the pilot (yes/no).
2) Share PO/SOW template or procurement checklist items you need in the MAP (we will add them as gating rows).

Requested deliverables from Sunnova (to start evaluation)
- 72h anonymized API traces (prefer JSON lines, remove PHI).
- Priority endpoints list (names + example request sizes).
- Single procurement contact for PO/SOW follow-up.

If that all looks good I’ll mark the MAP as "ready for procurement review" and upload v2 to the shared drive link above.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this to the eval run.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
